issues.body: The inline branch still accepts any non-empty value containing the substring `workflows`. Consequently, `workflow_run: {workflows: []}` passes despite an empty filter, while `workflow_run: {not_workflows: [CI]}` passes without the required key. Quoted scalar content can also create false acceptance. This is materially the same major issue reported in round 1, and `_SELF_TEST_CASES` still does not exercise flow-style mappings.
issues.fix_hint: Parse the flow mapping structurally and validate the exact `workflows` key with the same non-empty requirement as block mappings. Add self-test fixtures rejecting `{workflows: []}` and `{not_workflows: [CI]}`, and accepting `{workflows: [CI], types: [completed]}`.
issues.title: Inline workflow_run mappings still bypass structural validation

verdict.summary: Round 2 is stagnant: the prior major finding remains unchanged. Flow-style `workflow_run` mappings are still validated by a substring search rather than parsed structurally, so empty or similarly named keys bypass the gate, and the self-test table still has no flow-mapping fixtures. The lint therefore does not enforce its stated invariant.
